subject: System Design
title: Row vs Column Storage
description: Learn Row vs Column Storage in one minute.

hook.text: Query: average salary of 10 million employees. Row storage reads every column. Column storage reads just salaries.

buildup.text: Row-oriented stores keep all columns of a row together. Column-oriented stores keep all values of one column together.

discovery.text: Column stores compress data 10x better because values in a column are similar and highly compressible.

twist.text: Column stores are terrible for inserting single rows — every column file must be updated separately.

climax.text: OLTP workloads use row stores. OLAP analytics use column stores. Each is optimized for its use case.

punchline.text: Row stores for transactions, column stores for analytics.

quiz.question: Why are column stores better for analytics?
options: They read only the needed columns and compress better
They use less disk space overall
